_README: Competitive, pitch-based funding for Leads2Profit. These are surfaced to
Harry once a month in the nightly digest and NEVER emailed to anybody.
WHY THIS FILE HAS NO ADDRESS FIELD, AND MUST NEVER GAIN ONE
A cold email asking somebody to put money into a business is a financial
promotion under section 21 of the Financial Services and Markets Act.
Making one without FCA authorisation or an exemption is a criminal
offence. Asking an established body whether their own published scheme
covers you is a different act entirely - that is what
data/support_orgs.json's 'business support' entries do, and they are
emailed.
These are not that. A funding competition with rounds and a pitch is
something Harry enters himself. So this file carries no email, no
domain and no contact of any kind - not as a matter of policy that a
future edit could quietly reverse, but because the discovery pipeline
has nothing here to find. The absence is the guardrail.
Nothing that loads this file may ever call send_email(). Today exactly
one function reads it - funding_opportunities_reminder() - and its only
output is text for the digest.
VERIFY BEFORE APPLYING
Amounts and eligibility were correct when written and these schemes
change. Check the current round on the site before spending an evening
on an application.

opportunities.name: Scottish EDGE
opportunities.amount: up to GBP 100,000, split grant and loan
opportunities.shape: competition - fixed application rounds, pitch process
opportunities.note: Scotland's biggest business funding competition, for early-stage companies across all sectors. Rounds open and close on fixed dates, so the first thing to check is whether one is open. Real effort to enter - a pitch, not a form.

opportunities.name: Scottish Enterprise Small Capital Grant
opportunities.amount: GBP 15,000 to GBP 250,000, covering up to 50% of eligible costs
opportunities.shape: formal grant application, no cost to apply, not round-based
opportunities.note: Aimed at capital spend rather than running costs, so worth reading the eligible-costs list before assuming a software and marketing business fits. No fee to apply either way.

opportunities.name: Start Up Loans via X-Forces Enterprise
opportunities.amount: GBP 500 to GBP 25,000, 6% fixed, 1 to 5 years
opportunities.shape: government-backed personal loan for business use, plus 12 months free mentoring
opportunities.note: A loan rather than a grant, so it is a debt Harry would personally owe - listed here because the mentoring that comes with it has value on its own, not as a recommendation to borrow. X-Forces is also written to directly by the support outreach, which asks about eligibility rather than applying.
